items.title: Income tax return (ITR) filing

included: Choice of old or new tax regime

items.short_description: Accurate ITR filing by a chartered accountant, with every deduction you are entitled to.
items.description:
We compare the old and new tax regimes for you, check your AIS and Form 26AS for mismatches, claim every eligible deduction and file before the deadline. You get a computation sheet and the filed acknowledgement.

Who is it for?

Salaried people, pensioners, freelancers and people with capital gains from shares or mutual funds (capital-gains filing is ₹2,999).

items.location: New businesses, shops and online sellers

included: Eligibility check and advice on the right scheme
documents: Photograph of the owner or partners

items.short_description: Get your GSTIN quickly, with expert help on the right scheme for your business.
items.description: We help you decide between the regular and composition schemes, prepare the application and handle any clarification the department asks for.

items.title: GST return filing

items.short_description: Monthly GST returns filed on time, with input tax credit matched every month.
items.description: Send us your invoices by the 5th of each month and we take care of the rest — including reconciliation so you never lose input tax credit.

items.title: Monthly bookkeeping

data.heading: About Ledgerline Advisors
data.subheading: Chartered accountants for individuals, startups and growing businesses.

data.heading: Your finance team, without the overheads
data.description:
Ledgerline Advisors is a chartered accountancy firm in Ahmedabad founded in 2014. Our team of 28 — chartered accountants, company secretaries and tax specialists — works with individuals, startups and businesses across India.

We are registered with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (firm registration no. 123456W).

items.question: Are your fees fixed?
items.answer: Yes. Prices on this website are starting fees; we confirm a fixed fee before we start. Government fees and GST are extra.

items.question: Can you work with clients outside Ahmedabad?
items.answer: Yes — most of our work is done online for clients across India.

items.question: How do I share documents securely?
items.answer: We send you a private upload link. You can also share on WhatsApp or by email.

items.question: What if I receive a tax notice?
items.answer: Send it to us. Notice replies start at ₹2,499 and are free for our ITR clients for the same year.

data.content: We use your personal and financial information only to provide the services you engage us for, and we keep it confidential as required by the ICAI Code of Ethics. Documents are stored in encrypted storage and deleted on request after statutory retention periods.

Fees shown are starting prices and exclude government fees and GST. A fixed fee is confirmed in writing before work begins. Our responsibility is limited to the information you provide; please share complete and accurate documents.
